evals.expected_output: Flags $guarded = [] combined with User::create($request->all()) as a mass assignment vulnerability, since any field in the request (including something like is_admin) would be accepted.
Flags the N+1 query pattern (one query per reservation to load guest) and recommends eager loading with ->with(['guest']).
Flags that without scopeBindings(), {reservation} resolves globally and a request could pass a reservation ID belonging to a different hotel; recommends Route::scopeBindings().
